7223.title: Older-history prefetch starts too late for a fast climb
7223.rootCauseOneLine: A fixed 600 px prefetch threshold gives only about 150 ms of lead at 4,000 px/s, so a 300 or 900 ms older-page load remains pending at the loaded edge.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — addresses request lead distance
prReviews.topFinding: The diff increases lead distance using viewport height. It was not executed; its geometry test does not establish latency or native-fling behavior.

7223.proposedFix: Start bounded, viewport-aware prefetch sooner while preserving in-flight deduplication, error fallback, and scroll anchoring; validate with delayed pages and native touch/wheel input.
7223.caveats: Both clean-checkout hook reproductions agree. Native phone/trackpad behavior, the reported aggregate timings, server timings, and screenshots remain unverified: Browser Automation could not open because Chrome/Chromium is unavailable. Open PR #7224 already closes this issue; no duplicate fix was attempted.
